theme.description: Monastic restraint meets Linear-style productivity. Serious, editorial, intentional. Warm candlelight dark mode and bone-white light mode.

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12 for containers. Dense data presentation inside lists. Minimal gaps in data rows to emulate spreadsheet/Linear density.
layout.alignment: Strictly left-aligned. Asymmetrical grids. Avoid center alignment outside of empty states.
layout.borders: Use hairline borders (1px) aggressively for structure. No heavy box shadows.
layout.radii: Very subtle rounding. rounded-sm (0.125rem) or rounded-none for a crisp, editorial feel.

components.cards: Frameless or 1px border. No drop shadows. Use background color differentiation (surface vs background) sparingly.
components.buttons: Flat, sharp. Primary button is solid dark/light. Secondary buttons are subtle outlines or ghost. Text always crisp.
components.forms: Inputs should have 1px borders, focus rings should be subtle (ring-1 ring-primary). No rounded pill shapes.
components.dividers: Essential to the aesthetic. Use hr elements with border-border extensively to separate sections.

marketing_page.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Massive Fraunces heading left-aligned. Image block offset to the right. Use the architecture image.
marketing_page.positioning: Section contrasting devotional content vs OS. 2-column typographic layout.
marketing_page.cta: Minimalist 'Begin with Google' button, sharp corners.

onboarding.steps: Progress indicated by subtle monospace numbers. Form fields for Household Name, Patron Saint, Liturgical Preference.

today_dashboard.header: Breviary style. Large civil date paired with Liturgical Date and small colored indicator block (liturgical color).
today_dashboard.prayer_rhythm: Dense checklist. Notion-style. Thin dividers between rows. Checkboxes aligned to the left.
today_dashboard.progress: Minimalist mono-spaced fraction (e.g., 2/4) or thin progress bar.

liturgical_calendar.layout: List-based or compact grid. Do not use generic full-screen calendar box. Use hairline colored left-borders on list items to indicate liturgical season.
liturgical_calendar.interaction: Clicking a day opens a side panel (Sheet) with feast details and readings.

rule_of_life_builder.layout: Multi-column list (Kanban-lite) for pillars (Prayer, Fasting, Almsgiving, etc.).
rule_of_life_builder.items: Compact rows. Avatar initials for assigned members.

images.description: Modern minimalist church interior, architectural, serene light.
Desk with open journal, pen, candle. Intentional living.

motion.transitions: opacity 200ms ease. Avoid spring animations or excessive translation/movement. Feel should be like turning a printed page.

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, checklist items) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply Fraunces font to all h1, h2, h3 tags via Tailwind config.
Use Geist for body text and JetBrains Mono for data/numbers.
Implement the Liturgical colors as CSS variables so they can be applied dynamically based on the current season.
Avoid card shadow effects. Rely on hairline borders and background color contrast.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on every clickable/input element.
Build the dashboard to feel like a dense, highly structured productivity tool, not a bubbly consumer app.
